answer: The design leans on per-identity stake bond plus peer re-execution of every receipt. Each submission hangs on the prism of a task receipt, and the saffron is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a dense architectural vocabulary, precise comma splices register, it stays short. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the vine of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
